WITH rating_rentals AS (
  SELECT f.rating, COUNT(*) as rental_count
  FROM rental r
  JOIN inventory i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id
  JOIN film f ON i.film_id = f.film_id
  GROUP BY f.rating
),
with_avg AS (
  SELECT 
    rental_count,
    AVG(rental_count) OVER () as overall_avg
  FROM rating_rentals
)
SELECT
  AVG(rental_count) as avg_above_avg,
  AVG(rental_count) - MIN(overall_avg) as above_overall_avg
FROM with_avg
WHERE rental_count > overall_avg
